units: <cite ref="Menachot 64b:6">Men. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ צפרניו וכ׳</he> the swine pressed its nails against the wall; <cite ref="Sotah 49b:9">Sot. 49ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1:13">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵇ</cite>, a. e.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:1:18">Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>כשהיה נוֹעֵץ גודלו וכ׳</he> when he inserted his thumb into his month.
<cite ref="Shabbat 17a:6">Sabb. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>נָעֲצוּ חרב וכ׳</he> they stuck a sword into the floor of the college; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>נָעוּץ</he>.

senses.gloss: to cut a wedge-like ditch (נָעִיץ). Y. Sabb. V, 9ᵈ bot.; Y. Kil. VII, 31ᵇ bot., v. חָרַץ; a. e.

units: <cite ref="Shabbat 67a:18">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite> bot. (in an incantation, v. <cite ref="N00986"><he>נָעַל</he></cite>) <he>נִנְעַצְתָּה כמחט</he> (not … <he>תא</he>) thou art stuck in like a pin.
